name: tartan
description: Tartan: a running coach for your watch. Plans around your life, on your watch, with built-in rules, an AI on your phone or your own key.

scripts.build:web: rm -rf dist && bun build web/index.html --outdir dist --minify --splitting --define PUBLIC_BUILD=false --define BUILD_ID=\"$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M)\" && mkdir -p dist/maplibre && cp node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl-shared.mjs node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css dist/maplibre/
scripts.build:engine: rm -rf dist && bun build web/engine.html --outdir dist --minify --splitting --define PUBLIC_BUILD=false --define BUILD_ID=\"$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M)\" && mv dist/engine.html dist/index.html
scripts.build:engine:public: rm -rf dist && bun build web/engine.html --outdir dist --minify --splitting --define PUBLIC_BUILD=true --define BUILD_ID=\"$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M)\" && mv dist/engine.html dist/index.html
scripts.android:sync: bun run build:engine && cap sync android
scripts.android:sync:public: bun run build:engine:public && cap sync android
scripts.android:build: bun run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleOwnerDebug
scripts.android:build:public: bun run build:engine:public && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleFossRelease
scripts.build:web:public: rm -rf dist && bun build web/index.html --outdir dist --minify --splitting --define PUBLIC_BUILD=true --define BUILD_ID=\"$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M)\" && mkdir -p dist/maplibre && cp node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl-shared.mjs node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css dist/maplibre/
scripts.ios:sync: bun run build:web && cap sync ios
